title: Law requiring reports on gender-based violence hotline calls
summary: This bill would require the Mayor's Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence to annually report detailed statistics on its survivor hotline, including calls received, answered and abandoned, wait times, interpretation use, referrals, and calls by borough. The data would be broken down by month and cover the previous year. The report is due to the mayor and Council speaker no later than January 31 each year.
